newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Guthrie sees '97 pretax 400-450 mln rgt.
newsitem.headline: Guthrie sees '97 pretax 400-450 mln rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's Kumpulan Guthrie Bhd said on Tuesday that it sees pretax profit at 400 million to 450 million ringgit for the 1997 financial year.
"For 1997, I see pretax profit of between 400 to 450 million ringgit with turnover of 1,800-1,900 million ringgit," Guthrie's group chief executive officer Abdul Khalid Ibrahim said.
The plantations and property firm reported pretax profit of 377.38 million ringgit for the year ended December 31, 1996, on turnover of 1.61 billion ringgit. Net profit was at 151.54 million.
Speaking at an analysts' briefing, Khalid said he expected 50 percent of group pretax profit to come from property ventures, compared to 60 percent in 1996.
He said plantations would account for between 30 and 35 percent in 1997, against 38 percent in last year. The remainder would come from furniture products.
Klhalid said he expected to get regulatory approval for a 25 km highway project through the Klang Valley "within the next one or two weeks".
